messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated packet loss observed from POP eu-west-3 (edge-egress). Metrics: 12-18% packet loss, increased 5xxs for hosted-gen endpoints in eu-west. Trigger: synthetic + user errors. Pagerduty: PD-6789. http://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/1786005555
sre-oncall-1: ACK. I’m on it — setting Sev2. Paging network-eng and CDNs. Starting triage, will follow runbook: /runbooks/edge-packetloss
sre-oncall-1: @network-eng can you confirm if this is peering/infra in the POP or upstream? Also posting `mtr` to the host now, will paste results.
alex-k: oncall network-eng here. seeing BGP flaps from our edge router to PartnerA; some routes are transiently preferring an old path. Starting peering handshake with partner NOC. ETA 20m to confirm root cause.
network-eng: quick note: we’re seeing interface errors on spine-2 in eu-west-3, but counters are low; preliminary blame points to upstream peer. Partner NOC engaged.
sre-oncall-1: Running test:
```
mtr -c 100 -r api.eu.cdn.redwood.net
Start: 2026-03-15 02:45:10
HOST: s-rep1.yyz                             Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst
 1.|-- 10.0.0.1                              0.0%    100    0.4   0.5   0.2   1.2
 2.|-- 203.0.113.1                           0.0%    100    1.6   1.8   1.1   3.6
 3.|-- 203.0.113.45                         18.0%    100   12.2  14.3  11.8  73.6  <-- packet loss
 4.|-- 198.51.100.6                         0.0%    100   11.8  12.0  11.7  13.2
```
alex-k: confirms loss at hop 3 (203.0.113.45) which is PartnerA egress. Partner has been paged.
cdn-partner-bot: PartnerA NOC: We see increased packet loss on our peering leg at 203.0.113.45 impacting customers in eu-west-3. We are rerouting internal fabric traffic and will update in 15-20m. (ref: PA-INC-1122)
eng-platform-lead: Suggestive mitigation: shift traffic away from eu-west-3 POP to eu-west-1/eu-west-2 for affected routes via dynamic weight change. Preparing a gradual reweight (10% steps) to avoid cache churn. @sre-oncall-1 can you allow traffic steering for the region?
sre-oncall-1: Approved. Applying weight change with staged rollback. Command:
```
POST /api/v1/platform/traffic/shift
{ "region": "eu-west-3", "targets": ["eu-west-1","eu-west-2"], "step_pct": 10 }
```
sre-oncall-1: Starting shift now — shifting 10% away -> monitoring token-level latency and 5xxs. Patch in progress.
eng-platform-lead: Curl response 202 Accepted — rollout started. Rolling to 50% within ~18m if metrics remain stable.
ryan-cs: Heads-up: Customers with active sessions in eu-west may see transient tail latency and reconnects. Preparing status page update.
ryan-cs: Draft for status page:
"We are aware of elevated packet loss affecting customers in EU (eu-west-3). Traffic is being rerouted to nearby POPs. No data loss expected; some requests may see increased latency or retries. Next update in 20 minutes."
sre-oncall-1: Added to status page: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/1786005555 — monitoring.
network-eng: Partner reports they completed an internal fabric shift; packet loss reduced from 18% to ~4% on their side, but BGP flaps continue briefly. Reapplied stable peering, advising we keep traffic shift for 30m to be safe.
eng-platform-lead: Rolling down shift to 20% away (from 50%) to reduce cache miss while partner stabilizes.
cdn-partner-bot: Update: peering leg stable, BGP flaps cleared. We recommend validation for 30m before steering back.
sre-oncall-1: Customer impact estimate: ~6% of global requests, concentrated to EU customers, ~12 active enterprise customers observed with elevated error rates. No major data integrity issues reported. Severity remains Sev3 now.
maria-n: I’m taking over incident for the next shift. Handoff notes: partner perf improved, traffic currently 20% rerouted, watch 5xx and tail lat. Will coordinate with CS for customer follow-ups. @sre-oncall-1 please ping me if we see spike above 5xx threshold.
sre-oncall-1: Handing off — full context in thread. @maria-n — logs & runbook links: /runbooks/edge-packetloss, /dashboards/edge-pop-eu-west-3
maria-n: Ack. I’ll keep this thread open and post final POC once we normalize. Thanks team :heart:
ryan-cs: Sending follow-up email to top 10 affected customers now.
sre-oncall-1: Closing active page to on-call rotation, leaving monitoring alarms live. If metrics regress, we’ll re-open the page. 
maria-n: Noted — will close when traffic shifts back to baseline and partner confirms for 30m. Final update expected in ~45m.
